file_purpose: Structured ApplySmart research record for UEA Norwich Medical School A100 eligibility and interview guidance.

research_scope.course: University of East Anglia, Norwich Medical School, A100 MBBS Medicine
implemented: threshold-only GCSE and post-16 academic checks

evidence_classification_policy.historical_scale_policy: Legacy UCAT /3600 values are preserved as source evidence. Runtime Home guidance uses only explicit ApplySmart /3600 to /2700 normalisation for non-anomalous rows. Anomalous 2020 fields and unverified 2025 /2700 values are excluded.
evidence_classification_policy.offer_prediction_policy: Post-interview 50% UCAT and 50% interview formula is stored only as explanatory metadata and never used for offer prediction.

metadata.evidence_summary: UEA A100 uses GCSE and post-16 thresholds, requires UCAT, has no fixed UCAT cut-off, and ranks eligible applicants by UCAT for interview when oversubscribed. Home and International applicants follow the same published methodology while places are allocated against separate quotas.

source_validation_attempts.action: Searched local repository and supplied research directory for FOI_25-265, 2739, 2758, 2710 and 2730.
source_validation_attempts.result: No independent source snapshot was found beyond the supplied research file.

source_validation_attempts.action: Searched the web for UEA FOI_25-265 and the anomalous 2025 UCAT values.
source_validation_attempts.result: No accessible official source result confirming the values was found during implementation.

evidence_gaps: International-only UCAT interview statistics are not available in the supplied evidence.
Country-specific international qualification equivalency tables are not itemised.
2025 UCAT figures in the research exceed the stated 2700-point scale and are excluded pending source validation.
Scottish National 5 grade thresholds need manual review in the current runtime.

notes: Home interview guidance is available as low-confidence ApplySmart historical-normalised guidance.
International applicants can be checked for eligibility but receive insufficient-evidence interview guidance because International-only historical UCAT statistics are missing.
Contextual A100 adjustments are intentionally false because official evidence confirms no contextual A100 scheme.
